title: ENGINEERING SEPARATIONS
description: Design and analysis of unit operations employed in chemical engineering separations. Fundamental aspects of single and multistaged operations using both equilibrium and rate-based methods. Examples include distillation, absorption and stripping, extraction, membranes, crystallization, bioseparations, and environmental applications.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( CHEE E3010 and CHEN E2100 and CHEN E3110 ) and or instructor's permission.
